transcript.statement: The EfficiencyAgent emphasizes the need for performance efficiency in the autonomous driving system. Requirements EFF-01 and EFF-05 focus on optimizing travel time and achieving a high success rate in speed profile generation, which are crucial for user satisfaction and operational efficiency. EFF-02 and EFF-07 ensure passenger comfort while maintaining performance during emergency maneuvers. EFF-04 and EFF-06 address the need for real-time responsiveness and low latency in monitoring ODD compliance and handling obstacles. However, conflicts arise with SafetyAgent's emphasis on strict jerk limits and MRM execution, which may hinder performance efficiency.

conflicts_raised.description: The requirement to minimize jerk (SAF-04) conflicts with the need to maintain a jerk value below 0.5 m/s³ during normal operation (EFF-02), as relaxing jerk limits during emergency maneuvers may be necessary.
The requirement for executing MRM within 5 seconds (SAF-02) may conflict with the need for performance optimization during such maneuvers (EFF-03), potentially compromising efficiency.

The requirement to relax smoothness constraints during critical maneuvers (SAF-07) may contradict the priority of smoothness over speed during emergency maneuvers (EFF-07), leading to conflicting operational strategies.

positions.proposal: Consider relaxing jerk limits during emergency maneuvers.
Allow flexibility in MRM execution time to optimize performance.
Reassess the priority of smoothness during emergencies.

requirements.text: The system shall implement a multi-layer safety architecture including passive, active, and functional safety mechanisms to ensure collision protection and fail-safe operations.
The system shall execute a Minimal Risk Maneuver within a flexible time frame under strict safety protocols upon detecting critical failures.
The system shall continuously monitor Operational Design Domain compliance and issue a human takeover request when boundaries are approached.
The system shall establish a dynamic jerk limit that adjusts based on real-time conditions during emergency maneuvers.
The system shall satisfy curvature constraints to prevent rollover during maneuvers at all speeds.
The system shall utilize iterative quadratic programming to handle non-convex obstacle constraints reliably within a response time of 100 milliseconds.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during operation by optimizing path and speed profiles.
The system shall implement end-to-end data encryption for all user data transmitted to protect privacy and ensure data integrity.
The system shall ensure compliance with the Apollo Pilot Safety Report and EM Motion Planner specifications at all operational times.
